Context: 7. Ad hoc

## 7. Ad hoc  
allotment of quarters to handicapped employees may be  
Ad hoc considered in the following cases:-  
1. The blind, i.e., those who suffer from either of
2. (a) Total absence of sight.
3. Visual Acuity not exceeding 6/90 or 20/200 (snellen) in the better
4. (b) eye with correcting lenses.  
- Impression of the field of the vision subtending an angle of
- (c) 20 degrees or worse.
